answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11742 Country: Pakistan Title: AA We receive house building loans equal to 36 months basic pay salary from university and return it in 120 installments with 4% administrative charges. Is it halal or not? Question: AA We receive house building loans equal to 36 months basic pay salary from university and return it in 120 installments with 4% administrative charges. Is it halal or not? Answer ID: 11742 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 472/430=B/1430) The 4% administrative charge given with 120 instalments is not lawful, it is interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
